facts.fact: RITA says eRITA is a single digital platform and the only system used for CRVS, registering births, deaths, marriages, divorces and adoptions, with registration ongoing across all 26 regions.
RITA says deaths are among the vital events registered on the eRITA single digital platform.

systems.platform: web and Android apps, mobile phones at health facilities
systems.tiers: health facilities and ward offices, 12,025 registration points

note: Birth registration share of 68% (July 2024) is below 90%, so no coverage fact.
